To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the model based predictive speed controller with the aposteriori limitation is a suitable approach for the speed control of a system with torsional shafts.
the GPC is superior to the PI based speed control in terms of speed control performance and that the aposteriori limitation of the actuating values is necessary in practical applications.
the GPC is a suitable control method for a drive system that takes the torsion of a shaft into account.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model based control strategy for a drive system that takes the torsion behavior of the shaft into account.
the design and the practical implementation of a predictive speed control for a drive system including the torsional shaft dynamics.
the development of a predictive controller for a drive system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the model based predictive control approach is a suitable alternative to the classical PI control.
the model based predictive control is able to achieve a higher control performance in terms of a higher bandwidth and a faster response.
the predictive speed control is able to improve the dynamic behavior of the system significantly.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a model based predictive control approach can significantly reduce torsional oscillations.
a model based predictive controller can achieve a better speed response and can reduce torsional oscillations compared to a PI speed control.
the predictive speed control outperforms the PI based controller in all aspects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a predictive speed control can be successfully applied to a drive system with a torsional shaft.
the predictive speed control is superior to the PI based speed control with regard to both the achievable bandwidth as well as the robustness against load disturbances and torsional oscillations.
predictive control is a very powerful tool for drive systems with torsional loads, especially if the actuating signal is limited.
